records.context: Project to three (:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`). One pass over a fixed image data channel-to-RGB mapping. Cheaper, and irreversible: once image data channels are mixed, no downstream column can be attributed to a stain, and a screen cannot ask "was this the parasite image data channel or the host one?".

records.source: PROJECT TO THREE (:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`). One pass over a fixed channel-to-RGB mapping. Cheaper, and irreversible: once channels are mixed, no downstream column can be attributed to a stain, and a screen cannot ask "was this the parasite channel or the host one?".
records.translation: 投影到三个通道（:data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`）。对固定的图像数据通道到 RGB 的映射只做一次前向传播。更省算力，但不可逆：图像数据通道一旦混合，任何下游列都无法再归因到某一种染色，筛选也就无法追问“这来自寄生虫的图像数据通道还是宿主的图像数据通道”。
